subject: Commit bucket guidelines and sandbox demo (definitions + CRM updates)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@acme.com>
Cc: 
Bcc: 
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed commit / best-case definitions + sandbox demo (please review)

Team / Sarah,

Following up on our alignment call last week — attached is a concise update to the commit/best-case/pipeline buckets we want all AE/AMs using for Q3 forecasts. High-level:

- Commit: Opps with signed PO, or verbal legal/finance approval + purchase order expected within 30 days; pipeline value mapped to commit only if forecast category = "Commit" in CRM.
- Best Case: High-confidence land (decision-maker aligned, procurement engaged, contract in redline) but no PO yet.
- Pipeline / Upside: Early discovery or stalls where next step is unclear.

Why this change: it reduces double-counting between Best Case and Commit and gives Finance a cleaner revenue recognition preview. The attached `commit-defs-v2.pdf` shows the new threshold examples (>$50k auto-consider for tiered review) and a few CRM tagging rules.

Actions I need from the group before Friday:
1) Grace / Monica: quick review of CRM tagging checklist and confirm where we put "purchase_status" picklist.
2) Sarah: confirm Acme's preferred PO evidence (email thread vs vendor PO PDF).
3) All AEs on thread: join the sandbox demo — live walkthrough + hands-on changing stage values in a staging HubSpot workspace.

Sandbox demo details (recording + live Q&A): Thu Jun 17, 10:00–10:45 PT. Join link: https://meet.redwood.ai/commit-sandbox

Attachments: commit-defs-v2.pdf; sandbox-demo-steps.md; crm-update-checklist.xlsx

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
attach: commit-defs-v2.pdf (PDF, 210KB); sandbox-demo-steps.md (text, 6KB); crm-update-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet, 18KB)

Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed commit / best-case definitions + sandbox demo (please review)

Thanks Marcus — quick read looks good. Two clarifications from my side:

1) Best-case mapping for multi-product deals: do we want the entire ARR recognized as Best Case if only part of the SKU set has procurement approval? My preference is to require line-item approval or to prorate by SKU until PO covers full amount.

2) Training suggestion: rather than a single sandbox demo slot, can we add a 25-minute office-hour block the same day (Thu 11:15–11:40 PT) specifically for SDRs and new AEs to practice changing stages and seeing the downstream forecast roll-up? Short, hands-on sessions reduce mistakes in CRM tagging.

I can host the office hours if Marcus okays — will use the `crm-update-checklist.xlsx` as the working sheet.

Cheers,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Sales Enablement Manager, Redwood Inference
